t: Meeting with Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin
d: The President held a working meeting with Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin. Besides discussing current matters pertaining to Russia's socioeconomic development with the President, Mikhail Mishustin presented his proposals for appointments…

t: Greetings on the 35th anniversary of the Chamber of Commerce and Industry
d: Vladimir Putin sent greetings to the staff of the Chamber of Commerce and Industry of the Russian Federation on the occasion of its 35th anniversary.
